# TurnKey Remediation

> Water, fire and smoke, mold, sewage and odor cleanup, plus home and business cleaning, in New Orleans and the surrounding area. Answers 24/7. Free estimates.

Website: https://www.turnkeyremediation.com/
Last reviewed: 2026-11-04

## Business

- Name: TurnKey Remediation
- Based in: New Orleans, Louisiana
- Phone: (504) 285-5666. This is the only phone number for this business.
- Phone hours: 24/7, including weekends
- Office hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM Central
- Licensing: Residential License # 890459 and Commercial License # 3667
- Estimates: free
- Request an estimate: https://www.turnkeyremediation.com/contact/

## Services

- [Water Damage Restoration](https://www.turnkeyremediation.com/water/): Water removal, drying and repairs after burst pipes, roof leaks and flooding.
- [Residential Water Damage Restoration](https://www.turnkeyremediation.com/water/residential-water-damage-restoration/): Water damage in homes.
- [Commercial Water Damage Restoration](https://www.turnkeyremediation.com/water/commercial-water-damage-restoration/): Water damage in offices and other businesses.
- [Fire Damage Restoration](https://www.turnkeyremediation.com/fire/): Soot and smoke removal, odor cleanup and repairs after a fire.
- [Fire and Smoke Damage](https://www.turnkeyremediation.com/fire/fire-smoke-damage/): Fire and smoke cleanup for homes and businesses.
- [Mold Removal](https://www.turnkeyremediation.com/mold/): Mold cleanup for homes and businesses.
- [Residential Mold Removal](https://www.turnkeyremediation.com/mold/residential-mold-removal/): Mold cleanup in homes.
- [Commercial Mold Removal](https://www.turnkeyremediation.com/mold/commercial-mold-removal/): Mold cleanup in offices and other businesses.
- [Cleaning Services](https://www.turnkeyremediation.com/cleaning/): Home and business cleaning.
- [Air Duct and HVAC Cleaning](https://www.turnkeyremediation.com/cleaning/air-duct-hvac-cleaning/): Dust and buildup cleared from ducts and vents.
- [Carpet Cleaning](https://www.turnkeyremediation.com/cleaning/carpet-cleaning/): Stains, spills and odors in carpet.
- [Ceiling Cleaning](https://www.turnkeyremediation.com/cleaning/ceiling-cleaning/): Smoke, dust and stains cleaned off ceilings.
- [Commercial Cleaning](https://www.turnkeyremediation.com/cleaning/commercial-cleaning/): Floors, carpets, walls, ceilings and air ducts for businesses.
- [Floor Cleaning](https://www.turnkeyremediation.com/cleaning/floor-cleaning/): Tile and grout, hardwood, vinyl and carpet.
- [Odor Removal](https://www.turnkeyremediation.com/cleaning/odor-removal/): Smoke, sewage and musty smells, cleaned at the source.
- [Sewage Backup Cleanup](https://www.turnkeyremediation.com/cleaning/sewage-backup-cleanup/): Sewage backups and the cleanup after.
- [Wall Cleaning](https://www.turnkeyremediation.com/cleaning/wall-cleaning/): Smoke, grease and stains washed off walls.
